<tspan x="847.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: BatchNormFlow direct training profile. Evaluation reads running statistics; inverse training requires saved batch statistics.

sourceFacts: Mean/variance are vectors of length D. Source returns determinant shape [1], broadcastable across B.
Variance uses biased mean squared deviations and adds eps before sqrt; momentum weights the old value, unlike common PyTorch momentum naming.
State-update arrows indicate mutation; they are not the input used to normalize this batch.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
